title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-10 08:57:22 最新章节：第一百六十九章 叶孤云
content_zh:
沧澜大陆神州国。
南元城，楚家。
“楚天舒，独灵脉，资质：下等！”
启灵台上，老者经过再三检验，不可置信地说出天赋检测的结果。
“什么！他只有一条灵脉！”
“一条灵脉？我双灵脉还比他多出一条呢！”
“没想到……他资质竟如此之差！”
嘲讽挖苦声传来，不少楚家少年议论纷纷。
“下等资质……这……怎么可能？”
启灵台之上，楚天舒呆愣在原地，他脸上血色迅速褪去，近乎惨白！整个人就像被抽掉了骨头，半晌后才如同行尸走肉一般，强拖着身子下了台。
为什么？
我不是主角吗？
我可是穿越者啊！怎么只有下等资质？
没有“小绿瓶”，没有“系统”，没有“小塔”，没有“白发老爷爷”……什么金手指都没有！
果然，小说里都是骗人的！穿越异世获得金手指，纵横寰宇，后宫成群……都是假的啊，真信小说的这辈子有了！
楚天舒心中大骂：“靠！做事要讲良心！要讲良心啊！枉我给你们打赏了这么多月票！没穿越过就别写玄幻小说了行吗？我真的求了！xx苍穹，垃圾小白文！”
楚天舒很崩溃。他怎么都没自己居然只有一条灵脉。
在沧澜大陆上，凡是年满十四岁的少年，体内便会形成“灵脉”！灵脉可通过启灵石激活，激活之后，人们便可以通过灵脉来吸收天地灵气进行修炼。
灵脉越多，资质也就越高！
依据灵脉数量，人们把资质划分为四等：一至三条为下等，四至六条为中等，七至九条为上等，十至十二条则是万中无一的绝等！

在这弱肉强食、实力为尊的灵气世界内，资质天赋越高，未来所成就的境界也就越高！
而楚天舒只有一条灵脉，资质是下等中的下等！妥妥的废物一个。
“废了废了，这辈子废了。”楚天舒心想，“不过幸亏我还有两个丹心境的爹娘，算是投了个好胎，这辈子荣华富贵，衣食无忧也可以了。比起上辈子熬夜加班猝死，要好得多。”
修士境界可划分为：灵泽、脉络、丹心、融灵、化灵、灵域、高天七大境界！
丹心修士位于第三境，可以说是一人之下，万人之上！楚天舒父母正是两位丹心修士。
“下一位。”老者道。
闻言，台下一位容貌姣好的少女莲步轻移，与楚天舒擦肩而过时，她眼里生出了一丝轻蔑：“真没想到，他竟然只有一条灵脉，亏得家族寄托了那么多厚望。”
老者道：“将手放在启灵石上。”
少女深吸一口气，满怀期待地将手掌按压在启灵石上。
手掌接触的那一刹那，启灵石散发出光芒，六个烁金符文亮起，金光耀眼！
“楚玉，六灵脉，资质：中等！”老者声音高昂，浊目中带着赞赏。
“什么！六灵脉！”
content_en:
The Kingdom of China in Canglan Continent.
Nanyuan City, Chu family.
"Chu Tianshu, unique spiritual pulse, qualification: inferior!"
On the spiritual stage, after repeated tests, the old man told the results of the talent test in disbelief.
"What! He only has one spiritual vein!"
"One spiritual vein? I have one more spiritual vein than him!"
"I didn't expect...his qualifications are so poor!"
The sound of ridicule and sarcasm was heard, and many young people from the Chu family started talking about it.
"Inferior qualifications...how...is this possible?"
On the Ling Qi Ling Platform, Chu Tianshu froze on the spot, the blood on his face quickly faded, and he was almost pale! It was as if all the bones had been ripped out of his whole body. After a while, he dragged himself off the stage like a zombie.
Why?
Am I not the protagonist?
I am a time traveler! Why do you only have inferior qualifications?
There is no "little green bottle", no "system", no "little tower", no "grandpa with white hair"... no golden fingers!
Sure enough, everything in the novel is a lie! Traveling through another world to get a golden finger, traveling across the world, and having a harem... It's all fake. I really believe in the novel in this life!
Chu Tianshu cursed in his heart: "Damn! You have to be conscientious in doing things! You have to be conscientious! It's in vain that I rewarded you with so many monthly tickets! Can you stop writing fantasy novels if you haven't traveled through time? I really beg you! xx Sky, rubbish white novels!"
Chu Tianshu was devastated. He didn't even have one spiritual vein of his own.
On the Canglan Continent, any boy who is over fourteen years old will have a "spiritual vein" formed in his body! Spiritual veins can be activated through the Spiritual Enlightenment Stone. After activation, people can absorb the spiritual energy of heaven and earth through the spiritual veins for cultivation.
The more spiritual veins, the higher the qualifications!
Based on the number of spiritual veins, people divide their qualifications into four levels: one to three is inferior, four to six is ​​medium, seven to nine is superior, and ten to twelve is the absolute best!
In this aura world where the jungle prevails and strength is respected, the higher the qualifications and talents, the higher the level of achievement in the future!
But Chu Tianshu only has one spiritual vein, and his qualifications are the lowest among the lowest! A complete piece of trash.
"It's useless, it's useless, this life is useless." Chu Tianshu thought to himself, "But fortunately I still have two parents who are in a good mood. I was born into a good child. In this life, I can be prosperous and wealthy, and have no worries about food and clothing. It is much better than dying suddenly when I stayed up late and worked overtime in my previous life."
The realm of monks can be divided into seven realms: Lingze, Meridian, Danxin, Fusion of Spirits, Transformation of Spirits, Spirit Realm, and Gaotian!
Monk Danxin is located in the third realm. It can be said that he is inferior to one person and superior to ten thousand people! Chu Tianshu's parents were two Danxin monks.
"Next one," the old man said.
Hearing this, a pretty girl in the audience moved lightly. When she passed by Chu Tianshu, a trace of contempt appeared in her eyes: "I didn't expect that he only has one spiritual vein. It's a shame that the family has placed so many high hopes on it."
The old man said: "Put your hand on the spiritual stone."
The girl took a deep breath and pressed her palms on the Spiritual Enlightenment Stone expectantly.
The moment the palms came into contact, the Spiritual Enlightenment Stone emitted light, six golden runes lit up, and the golden light was dazzling!
"Chu Yu, Six Spiritual Veins, Qualification: Medium!" The old man's voice was high-pitched, with admiration in his eyes.
"What! Six spiritual veins!"
